name: czl-oracle-advisor
description: Traditional Chinese divination as a structured decision-reference workbench: a bundled astronomy and calendar engine casts four-pillar BaZi charts, Zi Wei Dou Shu palaces, Plum Blossom and Six-Line hexagrams, tarot spreads and almanac-based date candidates, then reads them into a layered judgement with explicit confidence, stated limits and concrete next actions.

displayDescription.en: Casts BaZi, Zi Wei, hexagram and almanac charts with a real calendar engine, then reads them into checkable structure and next actions instead of verdicts.
displayDescription.zh: 以八字、紫微、卦象与择日为决策参考框架，把看不清的事拆成可核对的结构与可执行的动作。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我排个八字盘，看看我的结构和今年该注意什么
defaultInitPrompt.en: Cast my BaZi chart and tell me my structure and what to watch this year

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我排个八字盘，看看我的结构和今年该注意什么
quickPrompts.en: Cast my BaZi chart and tell me my structure and what to watch this year

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我起一卦，看这件事现在该进还是该退
quickPrompts.en: Cast a hexagram for me: should I push forward on this now or hold back

quickPrompts.zh: 下个月要办婚礼，帮我挑几个日子并排出吉时
quickPrompts.en: Wedding next month — pick a few candidate dates and the auspicious hours
